scene campingtime1
good things come to those who wait! ~ companycorp is now announcing our latest project: an eighth of a location just outside of the gel kiosk in aisle nine west
lines.zh: 好东西属于愿意等待的人！ ~ companycorp 现在宣布我们的最新项目：位于九号西通道凝胶售货亭外侧的一处「八分之一」场地

lines.en: refill your kidneys at your own leisure with our brand new insertion technique ~ thread, what makes the family more familiar
lines.zh: 用我们全新的植入技术，随时为你的肾脏续杯 ~ thread，是什么让家变得更像家

lines.en: later this spring, a new presentation will take place beneath the main floor ~ the hole that swallowed everything and the impact it may have on your dating life
lines.zh: 今年春天晚些时候，主楼层下方将举行一场新的发布会 ~ 那个吞噬了一切的洞，以及它可能对你恋爱生活造成的影响

lines.en: are you feeling sad? try our brand new tongue depressor ~ made with real tongue! only at grayson’s. shop gray, shop grayson’s
lines.zh: 你难过吗？试试我们全新的压舌板 ~ 用真正的舌头制成！只在 grayson’s。买灰色，买 grayson’s

lines.en: looking for the exit? too bad! all exits have been blocked off for the immediate future. for more information, please visit our website ~ where VIP accounts are as free as you are.
lines.zh: 在找出口？可惜！所有出口在近期内都已被封锁。详情请访问我们的网站 ~ 那里的 VIP 账户和你一样免费。

lines.en: our next prayer circle begins in fifteen minutes! attendance is not mandatory, but encouraged.
lines.zh: 我们的下一场祈祷圈将在十五分钟后开始！不强制参加，但鼓励参加。

lines.en: remember to smile, daughter of the black page ~ the oyster is your world!
lines.zh: 记得微笑，黑页之女 ~ 牡蛎就是你的世界！

lines.en: scene black
one more lock removed/where feelers dare to fly
lines.zh: 又卸下一把锁/触须敢飞之处

lines.en: scene sky
$ totaldays += 1
$ day = 7
show sunday
I had a weird dream last night.
lines.zh: 我昨晚做了个奇怪的梦。

lines.en: I know that’s not really an uncommon thing to say at this point considering that I’ve even begun showing some of them to you, but this one was particularly strange even by my standards.
lines.zh: 我知道到这个地步，这句话其实已经不算稀奇——毕竟我甚至开始把其中一些拿给你看了——但即便以我的标准，这个梦也格外离奇。

lines.en: I possessed the body of a woman — not in the sense that I kept her chained up in a secret room of my house, but in the sense that I was quite literally inside of her body.
lines.zh: 我占据了一个女人的身体——不是那种把她锁在我家密室里的意思，而是我确确实实就在她身体里面。

lines.en: But it wasn’t like it was just my penis that was inside of her body. It was all of me. But not in a vore kind of way. Like, basically, I was just a woman.
lines.zh: 但那又不只是我的鸡巴在她身体里，而是我的全部。不过不是那种吞食的玩法。基本就是，我变成了一个女人。

lines.en: I wandered through the halls of an abandoned mall and came across a 500 yen coin that no vending machine would ever accept no matter how many times I tried to dump my findings into them.
lines.zh: 我在一座废弃商场的大厅里游荡，捡到一枚 500 日元硬币，可不管我往自动贩卖机里塞多少次，没有一台肯收。

lines.en: Eventually, there was a small man who offered to take the coin off my hands so long as I accepted his mystery box.
lines.zh: 后来有个小个子男人提出帮我把这枚硬币接手，条件是我收下他的神秘盒子。

lines.en: I took him up on the deal. And when I opened the box, there was a small child inside — wrapped in foil like a hot sweet potato, but one I could not legally take a bite of without incurring the wrath of the government.
lines.zh: 我答应了这笔交易。等我打开盒子，里面有个小孩——像烤地瓜一样用锡纸包着，只不过这根地瓜我咬一口就会招来政府的雷霆之怒。

lines.en: I took him home and fed him. I gave him a pile of dirt to play in and made sure to change the bulbs of his heat lamp every time it would start to dim.
lines.zh: 我把他带回家，喂他吃饭。我给他堆了一堆土让他玩，还每次加热灯泡一变暗就去换新的。

lines.en: Eventually, he grew into me and tried to give me (female version) a hug. So of course, I accepted.
lines.zh: 后来，他长成了我的样子，想抱抱我（女性版）。我当然就接受了。

lines.en: But when our skin made contact, I woke up in bed with a particularly grumpy yet despondent redhead staring down at me.
lines.zh: 可当我们的皮肤相触时，我在床上醒了过来，一个格外暴躁又沮丧的红发女孩正低头盯着我。

lines.en: scene campingtime2
And that’s basically how I wound up here.
lines.zh: 基本上，我就是这样来到了这儿。

lines.en: : You don’t seem very excited to be going camping anymore, Ami.
lines.zh: : Ami，你看起来对去露营这件事不太兴奋了。

lines.en: : Probably because you failed to mention the part about how we’d be going along with a bunch of older women.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你没提我们还要跟一群年纪更大的女人一起去。

lines.en: : Does that really change anything? Besides, you wouldn’t have agreed to come if I’d told you.
lines.zh: : 那真的改变什么了吗？再说，我要是早说了，你也不会答应来。

lines.en: : So you just tricked me instead?
lines.zh: : 所以你就骗我咯？

lines.en: : That’s right. And I regret nothing as this will ultimately bring us closer together.
lines.zh: : 没错。而我一点都不后悔，因为这最终会让我们更亲密。

lines.en: : Besides, there’s no way you didn’t realize last night that someone else was involved in this.
lines.zh: : 再说，昨晚你不可能没察觉到还有别人牵涉其中。

lines.en: : Obviously.
lines.zh: : 显然。

lines.en: scene campingtime3
: But I sure didn’t expect it to be three of them and that we’d all be going together.
lines.zh: : 可我真没想到会是三个，而且我们所有人要一起去。

lines.en: : My friend Yuki is coming too. But we didn’t have room in the car, so she’s just going to meet us there.
lines.zh: : 我朋友 Yuki 也会来。但车里坐不下，所以她直接在那里等我们。

lines.en: : You know you can drive a little faster, right Maki?
lines.zh: : 你知道你可以开快一点的，对吧 Maki？

lines.en: : No can do, Haru-kun. I’ve got precious cargo along for the ride this time.
lines.zh: : 不行哦，Haru-kun。这次我车上装的可是珍贵货品。

lines.en: scene campingtime4
: Kun?
lines.zh: : Kun？

lines.en: : That’s right. Because the boys are back in town and you’ll never guess what they do. They camp.
lines.zh: : 没错。因为男孩们回来了，而且你绝对猜不到他们要干什么。他们去露营。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : That’s us. We’re the boys.
lines.zh: : 就是我们啊。我们就是男孩。

lines.en: : I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。

lines.en: : So! Ami, have you ever gone camping before?
lines.zh: : 那么！Ami，你以前露营过吗？

lines.en: scene campingtime5
: No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Then, are you excited to try it out for the first time?
lines.zh: : 那第一次试试看，你兴奋吗？

lines.en: : I’m only doing this because Sensei said it would be good for our relationship and my entire life revolves around making him happy.
lines.zh: : 我来只是因为 Sensei 说这对我们的关系有好处，而我整个人生都围绕着让他开心转。

lines.en: scene campingtime6
: Ami, be more polite to Sara. She’s never done anything to get on your bad side before.
lines.zh: : Ami，对 Sara 礼貌点。她以前可从没做过什么惹你不高兴的事。

lines.en: : It’s fine, Sensei. I kind of get where she’s coming from.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Sensei。我有点懂她的感受。

lines.en: : I used to drag Sana around to go shopping when she was little and that was never really her thing. So if Ami’s only here to please you, that’s fine by me. We’ll all end up at the same place either way.
lines.zh: : 我以前也老拽着 Sana 去逛街，而那从来不是她的菜。所以如果 Ami 来这儿只是为了讨好你，我没意见。反正我们最后都会走到同一个地方。

lines.en: : I don’t have anything against Sana’s mom. She’s really nice and really pretty. I just also want her to leave us alone for the entire trip so you and me can properly bond.
lines.zh: : 我对 Sana 的妈妈没什么意见。她人很好，也很漂亮。我只是也想让她整趟旅程都离我们远点，好让你可以和我好好培养感情。

lines.en: scene campingtime7
: The whole trip? But I was looking forward to bonding with you as well!
lines.zh: : 整趟？可我也一直盼着跟你亲近亲近呢！

lines.en: Before I went to sleep last night, I wound up giving Sara a call and explaining the situation to her.
lines.zh: 昨晚睡觉前，我给 Sara 打了个电话，把情况跟她说了。

lines.en: And, since she (and everyone else) has been dying to help me so much lately, she wasted no time at all in accepting the role as Ami’s surrogate mother for the duration of the trip.
lines.zh: 而因为她（以及其他所有人）最近都急着要帮我，她二话没说就接受了在这趟旅程里当 Ami 的代理母亲这个角色。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say I expect her to adequately fill that role — especially when there’s one other girl vying for the same position and it’s one Ami seems to like significantly more, but still.
lines.zh: 但这不代表我指望她能充分胜任那个角色——尤其是还有另一个女孩在争同一个位置，而且那个女孩 Ami 明显更喜欢——不过，还是那句话。

lines.en: Sara’s already raised children. And, for reasons I will never understand, she seems to love it. So...maybe I’ll get lucky and Ami won’t entirely hate it and I can kind of...pick up a few tricks from her or something.
lines.zh: Sara 已经把孩子养大了。而且出于我永远不会理解的理由，她似乎很享受这件事。所以……也许我运气好，Ami 不会完全讨厌，我还能顺手……从她那儿学两招什么的。

lines.en: : You already have a daughter. I don’t want to take Sana’s place.
lines.zh: : 你已经有女儿了。我不想抢 Sana 的位置。

lines.en: scene campingtime8
Or maybe she’ll keep deflecting every opportunity Sara takes to try and shorten the gap between them.
lines.zh: 或者她会一直挡开 Sara 每一次试图缩短两人距离的努力。

lines.en: : Just because you aren’t my daughter doesn’t mean we can’t bond! We got along well when I came over to your house that one time, didn’t we?
lines.zh: : 就算你不是我女儿，也不代表我们不能亲近！我有一次去你家时，我们相处得不是挺好的吗？

lines.en: : Wait, really? Ami always tries to kick me out when I go to Sensei’s house.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？Ami 每次我去 Sensei 家都想把我赶出去。

lines.en: scene campingtime9
: I wouldn’t have to if you didn’t keep smuggling suitcases full of weird stuff into my living room.
lines.zh: : 你要是不一直往我家客厅里走私一箱箱奇怪的东西，我用得着赶你吗。

lines.en: : Wait, Maki — how often are you going over to Sensei’s place?
lines.zh: : 等等，Maki——你到底多久去一次 Sensei 家？

lines.en: : Often enough for this to be a recurring problem, apparently.
lines.zh: : 看来是经常到这都成了个反复出现的问题了。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m just trying to bump up my sales numbers. You two should be commending me as fellow business owners.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我只是想冲冲销量。你们俩作为同行该表扬我才对。

lines.en: scene campingtime10
: Ami, I would like to apologize on behalf of Maki for any strange objects she may have snuck into your house. And I can assure you that I do not have any strange objects in my possession whatsoever.
lines.zh: : Ami，我想就 Maki 可能偷偷带进你家的任何奇怪物品，代她向你道歉。而且我可以向你保证，我身上绝没有任何奇怪的物品。

lines.en: : Well, you’re in luck! Because my trunk is full of-
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你走运了！因为我的后备箱里装满了——

lines.en: : I would also like to apologize...on behalf of Maki in general.
lines.zh: : 我还想……就 Maki 这个人整体，道个歉。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I like you. I’m just not in a great mood.
lines.zh: : 没事。我喜欢你。我只是心情不太好。

lines.en: scene campingtime11
: Is it because you were looking forward to spending some alone time with your uncle?
lines.zh: : 是因为你一直盼着能跟你舅舅单独待一会儿？

lines.en: : Yes. And it doesn’t really help that I look like a demon either.
lines.zh: : 是。而且我看起来像个恶魔这事，也实在帮不上忙。

lines.en: : She’s going through a phase. She’ll break out of it soon, hopefully.
lines.zh: : 她正在经历一个阶段。希望她很快就能走出来。

lines.en: scene campingtime12
: Well, how about this? I just so happen to always travel with a full bag worth of haircare and fashion products, so how about I...fix you up a little bit? Does that sound fun?
lines.zh: : 那么，这样好不好？我碰巧总是随身带着一整袋的护发和时尚用品，要不我……把你收拾打扮一下？听起来有意思吗？

lines.en: : Ami doesn’t need fixing, Sara. Well...not like that at-
lines.zh: : Ami 不需要被修修补补，Sara。嗯……至少不是那种——

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 好啊。

lines.en: scene campingtime13
: Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: : Yeah, really?!
lines.zh: : 是啊，真的？！

lines.en: : Is that really such a surprise? Do you think I like looking like this? I hate it. And being self-conscious about that is one more reason I’m in such a bad mood right now.
lines.zh: : 有那么惊讶吗？你以为我喜欢自己这副样子？我讨厌死了。而为这个感到自卑，也是我现在心情这么糟的原因之一。

lines.en: : But yes, the other reason is that I wanted to be alone with Sensei. And now I can’t. So that’s just great.
lines.zh: : 不过没错，另一个原因是我本想和 Sensei 单独待着。而现在不行了。所以真是太好了。

lines.en: scene campingtime14
: On the bright side, you two will be able to share a tent at least. We were able to find an extra one in Sara’s storage room.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，至少你们俩能共用一个帐篷。我们在 Sara 的储藏室里找到了多出来的一顶。

lines.en: : Haru-kun’s right! The rest of us girls will share a different tent so the two of you can be alone for a little while. Your uncle already informed us of how important that would be.
lines.zh: : Haru-kun 说得对！我们其余的女生会睡在另一个帐篷里，好让你们俩能单独待一会儿。你舅舅已经跟我们说过那有多重要了。

lines.en: I did no such thing. But I’m glad to see that Maki’s going out of her way to lie for me.
lines.zh: 我可没说过那种话。不过看到 Maki 特意为我撒谎，我还是挺高兴的。

lines.en: scene campingtime15
: Can you please stop calling me Haru-kun?
lines.zh: : 你能别再叫我 Haru-kun 了吗？

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I can not. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 恐怕不能。抱歉。

lines.en: : And, I’ll tell you what — if at any point you find me overbearing or annoying, all you have to do is say the word and I’ll leave you alone.
lines.zh: : 而且我跟你说——任何时候你觉得我烦人或者碍事，你只要说那个词，我就离你远点。

lines.en: : What word?
lines.zh: : 什么词？

lines.en: : Haru-kun.
lines.zh: : Haru-kun。

lines.en: scene campingtime16
: Oh, come on!
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托！

lines.en: scene campingtime17
: I’m not asking to be left alone. This is just...a lot at once after not really talking to anybody for weeks.
lines.zh: : 我不是要你别管我。只是……好几周没怎么跟人说话之后，这一下子太多了。

lines.en: : It is, isn’t it? But you know what, Ami? I think you’re really brave. And I’m not just saying that because you were able to leave the house looking like that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，是不是？不过你知道吗，Ami？我觉得你很勇敢。而我这么说，不是因为你敢顶着那副样子出门。

lines.en: scene campingtime18
: I’m saying it because I know what it’s like to feel like a failure. And how you can’t help but blame all of the terrible things happening in the world on some stupid decisions you’ve made.
lines.zh: : 我这么说，是因为我知道觉得自己是个失败者是什么滋味。也知道你会忍不住把世上所有糟糕的事，都怪到自己几个愚蠢的决定上。

lines.en: : Maki feels that way too sometimes, I’m sure. But maybe not Haru-kun since she hasn’t had to experience anything traumatic just yet.
lines.zh: : Maki 大概有时也有这种感觉。但 Haru-kun 可能没有，因为她还没经历过什么创伤。

lines.en: : Knock on wood.
lines.zh: : 敲木头，别乌鸦嘴。

lines.en: : I’m just not going to get myself involved in this since I can’t imagine anything I have to say doing me any favors.
lines.zh: : 这事我就不掺和了，我想不出我说什么能给自己捞到好处。

lines.en: : How much do you know?...
lines.zh: : 你知道多少？……

lines.en: scene campingtime19
She knows everything.
lines.zh: 她什么都知道。

lines.en: Well...maybe not everything.
lines.zh: 嗯……也许不是全部。

lines.en: I made sure to leave out the part about how all of this anguish ultimately stems from the fact that I fucked the wrong high-schooler. But she knows about what’s going on with Ami at least.
lines.zh: 我特意略去了「这一切的痛苦归根结底都源于我操错了高中生」这一部分。但至少 Ami 这边的事她是知道的。

lines.en: Truth is, I didn’t want Sara saying the wrong thing since I know she always goes overboard when it comes to parenting. So I told her about the scissors.
lines.zh: 其实，我不想让 Sara 说错话，因为我知道她一涉及育儿就容易过头。所以我告诉了她剪刀的事。

lines.en: I told her about the mental breakdowns and the organ-harvesting rant in the classroom.
lines.zh: 我告诉了她精神崩溃的事，还有在教室里那通贩卖器官的疯话。

lines.en: I even told her about how Ami’s feelings for me are a bit more than just a niece’s love for her uncle.
lines.zh: 我甚至告诉了她，Ami 对我的感情，比一个侄女对舅舅的爱要多那么一点。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
But again, I conveniently left out the part about how I’ve reciprocated those feelings on many occasions and have had to wash her dried fluids off my cock more times than I can even count.
lines.zh: 不过还是那句话，我顺手略去了「我多次回应了那份感情，而且不得不洗掉我鸡巴上她干掉的体液，次数多得我都数不清」这一部分。

lines.en: The thing is, I trust Sara.
lines.zh: 问题是，我信任 Sara。

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
She’s the only one who really gets what I’m going through concerning all of the...blackouts and whatnot.
lines.zh: 关于所有那些……断片什么的，她是唯一真正懂我在经历什么的人。

lines.en: And I don’t expect her to say the wrong thing because, even if she isn’t the best mom out there, she’s empathetic. And compassionate.
lines.zh: 而我不指望她说错话，因为就算她不是世上最好的妈妈，她也有同理心。还有同情心。

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter what I know. What matters is what I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我知道什么并不重要。重要的是我不知道什么。

lines.en: scene campingtime20
And...kind of amazing.
lines.zh: 而且……还挺了不起的。

lines.en: The way she can smile like that after losing a son is something I can only hope to emulate. And all that I’ve lost has had different colored blood than me.
lines.zh: 她在失去一个儿子之后还能那样微笑，是我只能希望自己能模仿的事。而我所失去的一切，流的都是跟我不同颜色的血。

lines.en: So yeah...the point of this trip is to paint myself in one of those colors and hopefully emerge looking slightly more like a father figure.
lines.zh: 所以是啊……这趟旅行的意义，就是把自己涂成那种颜色之一，但愿出来的时候能稍微更像个父亲。

lines.en: But it might be good for me as well — to walk in the shadow of someone who can find the shade and make all of this look whole again.
lines.zh: 但对我自己也许也有好处——走在某个能找到阴凉的人的影子里，让这一切重新看起来完整。

lines.en: : Let’s try and have some fun today, okay?
lines.zh: : 今天我们试着玩得开心点，好吗？

lines.en: : Even if it’s only for twenty-four hours, let’s pretend like we’ve left Kumon-mi altogether and picture ourselves in a happier place where we can start all over.
lines.zh: : 就算只有二十四小时，让我们假装自己已经彻底离开了 Kumon-mi，把自己想象在一个更快乐的地方，可以从头再来。

lines.en: : No worries...no drama...just grass. And bugs. And marshmallows. And anything else that Maki has packed into her trunk that won’t make us all look like insatiable nymphomaniacs.
lines.zh: : 没有烦恼……没有闹剧……只有草。还有虫子。还有棉花糖。以及 Maki 塞进后备箱里任何不会让我们全都看起来像欲求不满的性瘾者的东西。

lines.en: : I’ll try, but...why are you so concerned about how I feel when you barely even know me?...I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我会试试的，可是……你明明都不怎么认识我，为什么这么在意我的感受？……我不懂。

lines.en: : I know more about you than you think, Ami. It’s not like Sensei never talks about you.
lines.zh: : 我知道的关于你的事，比你想的要多，Ami。Sensei 又不是从不提起你。

lines.en: scene campingtime21
: Does he?...
: Plus, moms don’t need a reason to be concerned about things like that.
lines.zh: : 再说，妈妈们关心这种事，是不需要理由的。

lines.en: : Even if you’re not Sana, I still feel the need to protect you and nurture you. So that’s what I’m going to do until you ask me to stop. And even then, I’ll never stop feeling this way.
lines.zh: : 就算你不是 Sana，我依然觉得有必要保护你、养育你。所以在你叫我停下之前，我都会这么做。而就算到那时候，我也永远不会停止这种感觉。

lines.en: : It just comes with the territory, I guess. And it’s territory I’m sure your uncle’s familiar with if he was worried enough to venture this far out of his comfort zone just to try and make you happy.
lines.zh: : 我想这大概是这份职责自带的东西。而这份职责，你舅舅肯定也熟悉——如果他担心到愿意为了让你开心，跑到离自己舒适区这么远的地方来。

lines.en: scene campingtime22
: Yeah.
: He’s pretty amazing, isn’t he?...
lines.zh: : 他挺了不起的，不是吗？……

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 也不怎么样。

lines.en: : He really is.
lines.zh: : 他真的很了不起。

lines.en: : There’s a part of what you said that needs to be fixed, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你刚才说的话里，有一处需要改一下。

lines.en: scene campingtime23
: There is?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah.
scene sky
: He doesn’t want to be my “uncle” anymore.
lines.zh: : 他不想再当我「舅舅」了。

lines.en: : And how does that make you feel?
lines.zh: : 那这让你有什么感觉？

lines.en: : You don’t have to answer, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你不必回答，Ami。

lines.en: : I’ll answer.
lines.zh: : 我会回答的。

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: scene black
: I’d like to do it in private.
lines.zh: : 我想私下说。

lines.en: I’m not sure how long we remain in the car before Maki quite literally ventures off the beaten path down a long dirt road that will either take us to our destination or send us speeding off a nearby cliff.
lines.zh: 我不确定我们还在车里待了多久，Maki 才真的驶离大路，拐进一条长长的土路——那条路要么把我们带到目的地，要么让我们加速冲下附近的悬崖。

lines.en: And if the latter happens, fine. That would actually be a pretty poetic death considering the scenario and the conversations we had leading up to it.
lines.zh: 而如果是后者，那也挺好。考虑到眼前的情境和我们在此之前聊的那些话，那其实会是个相当诗意的死法。

lines.en: But I’m looking for a different sort of fresh start.
lines.zh: 但我在寻找另一种重新开始。

lines.en: One that will allow me to continue being the sad sack of shit I am, but with a slightly less sad sack of shit looming over me at all times.
lines.zh: 一种能让我继续做我这坨可悲废物的方式，只不过头顶上时刻笼罩着的那坨，没那么可悲一点。

lines.en: Watching my every move.
lines.zh: 注视着我的每一个动作。

lines.en: Always thinking about me.
lines.zh: 总是想着我。

lines.en: Less like a niece-
lines.zh: 不那么像个侄女——

lines.en: And more like a daughter.
lines.zh: 而更像个女儿。
